coverage_assessment: 28 captured English, Dari/Persian and Pashto search invocations (651 returned headers) covered all January week windows, Quran-burning protests, pensions/workers, women/education and Dec/Feb continuity. Five provisional event records and one screened foreign-target exclusion are documented. The open-web set is not equivalent to the original LexisNexis universe; local site thresholds, targets, ends and direct state responses remain unresolved; official baseline pending.
